name: Samaiden Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Samaiden 与 Parkland Renewable Energy 签署 MOU，计划在马来西亚半岛开发合计最高 1,000 MWac 的 CRESS 可再生能源项目；同时完成以 RM45,500,000 收购 Teluk Intan, Perak 约 185.57 公顷租赁土地。另一方面，公司终止了柬埔寨两项未达成最终合约的 MOU（Royal Railway Concession 项目及 Kampong Seila 沼气项目）。
overview_en: In 2026, Samaiden signed an MOU with Parkland Renewable Energy to collaborate on CRESS renewable energy projects in Peninsular Malaysia with aggregate installed capacity of up to 1,000 MWac, and completed the acquisition of approximately 185.57 hectares of leasehold land in Teluk Intan, Perak for RM45,500,000. Separately, the company terminated two Cambodia MOUs (the Royal Railway Concession project and the Kampong Seila biogas project) after no definitive contracts were entered into.

segments.name: 太阳能光伏系统 EPCC
segments.note: 今年与 Parkland Renewable Energy 签署 MOU，拟在马来西亚半岛合作开发 CRESS 项目，并完成 Teluk Intan 土地收购。
segments.note_en: During the year, signed an MOU with Parkland Renewable Energy to collaborate on CRESS projects in Peninsular Malaysia and completed the Teluk Intan land acquisition.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Parkland Renewable Energy 签署 MOU，拟在马来西亚半岛合作识别、开发及实施 CRESS 可再生能源项目，合计装机容量最高 1,000 MWac。
actions.text_en: Signed an MOU with Parkland Renewable Energy to collaborate in identifying, developing and implementing CRESS renewable energy projects in Peninsular Malaysia with aggregate installed capacity of up to 1,000 MWac.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Samaiden Capital Management 以 RM45,500,000 完成收购 Teluk Intan, Perak 两幅 99 年租赁地契土地，合计约 185.57 公顷。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Samaiden Capital Management completed the acquisition of two parcels of 99-year leasehold land in Teluk Intan, Perak measuring approximately 185.57 hectares in aggregate for RM45,500,000.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述 Teluk Intan 土地收购的买卖协议条件全部达成，协议转为无条件。
actions.text_en: All conditions precedent of the SPA for the Teluk Intan land acquisition were fulfilled, and the SPA became unconditional.
